Game Overview

Gozu Adventures 2 is a adventure title where guide the playful robot Gozu through a whimsical world filled with danger and cupcakes. Master platforming skills and clever timing in this thrilling sequel, jumping through eight levels of increasing challenges with the help of your trusty double jump. Can you navigate each perilous level to victory?
